prompt: Tiling ground terrain texture: earth crushed flat by something titanic and glazed in its passing - a hard trench floor of packed crust, slag crumbs and metal-salt smear, dull grey-brown with faint parallel drag marks and fused glassy flecks. Must tile seamlessly edge-to-edge. Painterly vanilla-RimWorld terrain art style, top-down, muted palette (def tint 0.52,0.48,0.40) low value range so a colonist sprite reads on top. Full-bleed opaque seamless tiling texture filling the entire canvas edge to edge -- no transparency, no isolated subject, no vignette, no border; every edge must wrap to its opposite edge.
